description: This file defines the ImageImporter class responsible for importing images of various formats within the PDFsharp library. It manages different image importers and handles image loading from streams and files.

classes.name: ImageImporter
classes.description: A class that imports images of various formats, supporting multiple image types via registered importers.

methods.name: GetImageImporter
methods.description: Static method that returns a new instance of ImageImporter. It hints at a singleton pattern but currently creates a new object each call.

methods.name: ImportImage
methods.description: Imports an image from a stream, handling stream length and exceptions, returning an ImportedImage or null.

methods.name: ImportImage
methods.description: Imports an image from a filename by reading all bytes and attempting to import via stream helpers.

methods.name: TryImageImport
methods.description: Attempts to import the image using all registered importers and returns the first successful result.
